title: Face recognized
description: A face was seen at a monitoring point and matched (or failed to match) against the company's enrolled gallery. Emitted once per visit, not per frame: the producer holds a face for a few consecutive frames before deciding, and stays quiet about the same person for a cooldown afterwards. Matching happens on the box against the gallery it pulled from the backend, so the payload names the enrolled person, never carries the face itself. Deliberately purpose-agnostic: time attendance reads it, a restricted-area or visitor module could too.

match.description: known: the best gallery match cleared the instance's threshold. unknown: a face was held long enough to decide and nobody in the gallery matched.

person_ref.description: The enrolled person's id as the gallery gave it. Required when match is known, absent when unknown.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity of the best gallery match (the best one even when unknown, so thresholds can be tuned from history).

threshold.description: The threshold the box compared against, so an event stays interpretable after the instance config changes.

frames_held.description: Consecutive frames the face was tracked before the decision.

model.description: Recognizer that produced the embedding, e.g. 'sface-2021dec'. Embeddings from different models are not comparable.

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] pixel coords in the source frame.
